title: docs/CONTRIBUTING.md is linked from no other document of README.md + docs/*.md
claim: Of the 8 docs/*.md documents, exactly one, docs/CONTRIBUTING.md, has zero inbound links from README.md or any other docs/*.md; README's Documentation table lists the other seven plus DISCLAIMER.md and docs/index.html but not it.
mechanism: The contributor guide was added without a row in README.md's 'Documentation' table or a link from architecture.md, the developer-facing document; a reader reaches it only through GitHub's repository sidebar, which surfaces docs/CONTRIBUTING.md automatically.

evidence.contention_note: box heavily loaded; counts are contention-immune

instrumented_symbol: tools/audit/text_ledger.py:outline (link rows) driven over README.md and docs/*.md

perturbation.change: --link-orphans: in memory, one README.md link to docs/CONTRIBUTING.md

metric_definition: docs/*.md documents with no inbound link from any other document among README.md + docs/*.md (outline link rows, paths resolved relative to the linking file).
phenomenon_property: Every document under docs/*.md is reachable by a link from README.md or another docs/*.md document.
proposed_fix_scope: Add a docs/CONTRIBUTING.md row to README.md's Documentation table (and optionally link it from docs/architecture.md's opening, the developer reader's entry).
